domain_restrictions: n is an integer and n is greater than 1
k ranges over integers from 1 to n inclusive
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every integer n greater than 1, define F_n on all real numbers by F_n(x) equals floor of n times x minus the sum from k equals 1 to n of floor of k times x divided by k. Then for every real x and every integer z, F_n(x plus z) equals F_n(x).
quantifier_order: for all integers n with n greater than 1

variables.name: n
variables.role: fixed parameter of the function F_n; also the upper limit of the finite sum

variables.name: z
variables.role: integer shift added to the input of F_n

variables.domain: integers from 1 to n inclusive (where n is the fixed parameter)
variables.name: k
variables.role: dummy index in the finite sum

witness_dependencies: no existential quantifiers; the claim is a universal invariance statement with respect to z

statement_nl: Let n be an integer greater than 1, and define F_n(x) = floor(n x) - sum_{k=1}^{n} floor(k x)/k. Then for every real x and every integer z, F_n(x + z) = F_n(x).
